title: Gluten-Free Diet: A Synthetic Example
subtitle: Group composition among gluten avoiders
population_definition: A fictional population at each labeled period. Its gluten-avoiding subgroup is partitioned into mutually exclusive, exhaustive fictional Groups A, B, and C. Values are not historical estimates.

units.composition_pct: percent of the synthetic gluten-avoiding subgroup
units.population_share_pct: percent of the synthetic total population

footer_lines: SYNTHETIC DATA. Groups A–C are fictional; each bar totals 100% of gluten avoiders.
Population share = gluten avoiders as a percentage of the fictional total population.
